retainedQualifications: Registry/main/support/adoption facts are dated; no comparative popularity winner is proven.
No Zag interpreter or second state owner is selected; remove-scroll scope is separate.
Fuzzy probes are small/default-config; synthetic connectors and skipped upstream tests are not runtime passes.
Adobe parser alone is not full control; wrong nonstandard notation is explicitly rejected.
ELK is layout, not a fixed-position router; local sizes/timings are not browser/CDN claims.
Alternative diagram libraries retain precise license/lifecycle/accessibility limits.
Local date patch does not reach consumers without private-runtime delivery.
Reduced-motion cause is document CSS, not a diagnosed standalone WebKit defect.
Blanket polyfill deletion conflicts with later selected scoped compatibility; old avoid-match-sorter/no-vanilla advice is superseded.
